title: Grateful Dead Live at Travelodge Theatre in the Round on 1970-03-08

ai_review.summary: Decent‑sounding recording hampered by mis‑labelled tracks and mixed feelings about Pigpen’s vocals.
ai_review.review: The audio is generally clear enough for listeners, but the track titles are wrong (Hard to Handle appears as “Dire Wolf”). Reviewers describe a pleasant atmosphere and decent sound quality, yet the performance of the harmonica/vocalist draws strong criticism. Overall the show elicits both enthusiasm and irritation.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split – one zero‑star complaint about mislabeled files, a middle rating praising sound, and polarized opinions on the singer/harpist. The average star score is low (≈2.75) and technical comments are limited, leading to a modest overall rating with medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the sound is acceptable, but track titles are incorrect (Hard to Handle labeled as “Dire Wolf”). No specific comments on board vs. audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed remarks on song order; listeners focused on venue ambience and the vocal/harp performance rather than set structure.
